summary_1line: Sampati recounts to the sage how pride led him and Jatayu to chase the sun, where he shielded his brother and was burned and cast down.

image_candidates.scene_text: High above the earth, Sampati spreads his vast wings to shield the falling Jatayu from the blazing sun.
Two mighty birds race toward the glaring sun while the world far below appears as tiny mountains and threadlike rivers.
Sampati, his wings scorched by the sun’s heat, spirals downward from the sky after saving his brother.
